verdict.rationale: Morph is an OpenAI-compatible inference API, so embeddings and reranking are a fair capability to ask about. However, the evidence documents only chat models, Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact and Reflexes classifiers, with no embeddings or rerank endpoint. WarpGrep's semantic code search is an adjacent feature, not a developer-facing embeddings or rerank API, so it earns no credit.
